RAAGUL SARAVANANMALA Fund Accounting & Pricing Professional | NAV Calculation | Trade Confirmation | Pricing | Reconciliation

Chennai, India | +91 97890 60429 | smraagul77@gmail.com | Open to Relocate

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Fund Accounting and Investment Operations professional with 4+ years of experience in global asset management and banking operations, specializing in NAV calculation, fund valuation, trade pricing, portfolio reconciliation and financial reporting. Experienced in supporting European and Asian fund portfolios across equities, fixed income, mutual funds, futures, swaps, options and UCITS. Strong experience in investment accounting, corporate actions, expense accruals, management and performance fee calculations, exception management and audit support. Proven ability to improve operational controls through automation and Excel-based reconciliation solutions while working with global stakeholders to deliver accurate and timely fund outputs.

CORE SKILLS

Fund Accounting Operations • Portfolio / Cash / Position Reconciliation • Expense Accruals & Fee Calculations • Financial Reporting & Audit Support

NAV Calculation & Fund Valuation • Investment Accounting • Exception Management • Advanced Excel / VBA

Trade Booking, Confirmation & Pricing • Corporate Actions • Derivatives – OTC & Exchange-Traded • KPI & Operational Reporting

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

BNY Mellon International Operations Financial Planning & Analysis Representative

Oct 2025 – 29 Jul 2026

Managed budget tracking and utilization across three teams—Service Delivery, Infrastructure and Development—covering software, hardware and technology service spend.

Supported the Procure-to-Pay process by creating and managing Purchase Orders while ensuring compliance with procurement policies and purchasing controls.

Coordinated with Vendor Management and internal stakeholders for supplier onboarding, PO processing and timely procurement. • Supported leadership teams on process enhancement, automation initiatives and control-strengthening programmes. • Performed invoice coding and validation for 50+ invoices per month, ensuring accurate cost allocation and timely submission to Accounts Payable.

Automated recurring financial reporting and management approval workflows using SharePoint, reducing manual effort by 60% and improving audit-documentation efficiency.

BNP Paribas Global Securities Operations Pvt. Ltd.

May 2022 – Oct 2025

Fund Accounting & Trade Settlement Analyst

Managed the post-trade lifecycle from trade execution and CTM confirmation through settlement, reconciliation and exception resolution, with focus on downstream accounting and NAV impact across multiple asset classes.

Performed trade confirmation and portfolio pricing across Asian and European markets using Bloomberg, Datascope and IDC, validating trade and pricing information before NAV finalization.

Performed trade capture and validation through CTM, reviewing fund/account, security, quantity, price, trade date, settlement date, currency and counterparty details before downstream processing.

Performed bulk trade uploads and pre-upload validation, reviewing trade files for completeness, accuracy and required trade attributes to minimize processing errors and STP breaks.

Investigated and resolved STP breaks and unmatched trades relating to trade attributes, settlement information and SSI, coordinating with brokers, custodians and internal teams before NAV finalization.

Validated and maintained Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), identifying incorrect or missing settlement details and coordinating corrections to reduce settlement exceptions.

Utilized TLM for reconciliation and exception management, investigating trade, cash and position breaks, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating resolution with stakeholders.

Performed daily cash, securities and derivatives reconciliations with Asset Management, Accounting, Transfer Agents and Depositary Banks, covering IRS, FX Forwards, Options and Futures.

Verified transactions across Equities, Bonds, Funds, Futures, Swaps, Options and Forwards, ensuring accurate accounting and downstream position and valuation reporting.

Investigated pricing, valuation, accounting, cash and position breaks through exception management and root-cause analysis. • Processed corporate actions including dividends, stock splits, mergers, interest accruals and other market events, ensuring accurate fund portfolio accounting.

Performed portfolio valuation and management/performance fee calculations for European client portfolios in accordance with fund agreements and supported accurate NAV reporting.

Raagul Saravananmala | Fund Accounting & Investment Operations

• Supported derivative clearing activities and developed practical knowledge of clearing workflows and their downstream impact on

trade processing and fund accounting.

Worked with CDS product information and clearing workflows as part of derivative and fund accounting operations. • Prepared KPI reports and supported audit-query resolution for Asian and European mutual fund clients, coordinating with the Client Account Management team for timely deliverables.

Key Achievements

Reduced manual effort in Corporate Action validation by 60% during trade pricing by collaborating with technical teams to develop an internal automation tool.

Demonstrated leadership in client onboarding, transition management, process migration and operational stabilization for high- priority initiatives.

Developed an Excel macro for portfolio reconciliation by matching portfolio positions against custody files, reducing reconciliation time by 70%.

Contributed to governance frameworks, operational controls, reporting standards and process documentation across multi- jurisdictional fund operations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Fund Accounting & Investment Operations: NAV Calculation | Fund Valuation | Investment Accounting | Corporate Actions | Financial Reporting | Reconciliations | Expense Management | Mutual Funds | European Fund Operations | Derivatives (OTC & Exchange-Traded) | MTM Valuation

Systems & Platforms: Multifonds | Bloomberg | Reuters | IDC | WEM | P Control

Analytics & Reporting: Advanced Excel (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, VBA) | Power BI | Tableau | Financial Analysis | Data Validation

EDUCATION

M.Com in Finance — MGC College, Chennai | 2021 | 80% • B.Com — SV Arts College, Gudur | 2019 | 79%

CERTIFICATIONS

Investment Analyst Certification | 2022 • Business Analyst Program — UpGrad in association with PwC | 2025

LANGUAGES

Tamil, Telugu, English (Fluent) | Hindi (Intermediate)
